notes.title: Tacitly's original song “Wake Me Up” English and Chinese version added!
notes.notes:
Lilia and Ciel are a virtual singer unit.
With the goal of “connecting the world through music”, they have released 11 original songs in three languages (Japanese, Chinese, and English). They are also actively performing overseas as well.
Their original song “Wake Me Up” will be available on Atchmo in three different languages.
listen more ⇒https://lnk.to/_wakemeup
